                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Euthphr.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3b</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ὥς γε οὑτωσὶ ἀκοῦσαι</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg020:216a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Ly.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">216a</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>.</sense>
          <sense n="IV" id="n3398.18" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">understand, take</tr>in a certain sense,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg2003.tlg001:4:147a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Jul.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Or.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.147a</biblScope>
            </bibl>; esp. in Scholl., as Sch.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg016.perseus-grc1:333" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Or.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">333</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τι ἐπί τινος</foreign>Sch.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg005.perseus-grc1:73" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Hipp.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">73</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="V" id="n3398.19" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">Astrol.,<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">aspect mutually</tr>, of signs equidistant from an equinoctial sign,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg1337.tlg001:189" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Doroth.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">189</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Heph.</author>
            </bibl>Astr.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg1402.tlg001:2:2" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.2</biblScope>
            </bibl>; also,<xr opt="n" TEIform="xr">
              <lbl opt="n" TEIform="lbl">=</lbl>
              <ref targOrder="U" lang="greek" TEIform="ref">ὑπακούειν</ref>
            </xr>(q. v.),<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg1402.tlg001:1:9" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.9</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>

<entryFree id="n6207" key="ἄν1" type="main" opt="n" TEIform="entryFree">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="orth">ἄν</orth>(A),<pron extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="pron">[ᾰ]</pron>,<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
            <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ep.</gram>
          </gramGrp>, Lyr.,<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
            <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ion.</gram>
          </gramGrp>,<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
            <author TEIform="author">Arc.</author>
          </bibl>,<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
            <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
          </gramGrp>; also<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">κεν</itype>)<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
            <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ep.</gram>
          </gramGrp>,<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
            <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Aeol.</gram>
          </gramGrp>, Thess.,<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">κᾱ</itype>
          <gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
            <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Dor.</gram>
          </gramGrp>,<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
            <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Boeot.</gram>
          </gramGrp>, El.; the two combined in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
            <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ep.</gram>
          </gramGrp>(infr.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg011.perseus-grc1:2" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
            <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
            <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">11.2</biblScope>
          </bibl>) and<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
            <author TEIform="author">Arc.</author>
          </bibl>,<sense id="n6207.0" n="A" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">εἰκ ἄν</quote>
              <bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <title TEIform="title">IG</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5(2).6.2</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>,<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">15</biblScope>
            </bibl>
            <date TEIform="date">(iv B. C.)</date>:—modal Particle used with Verbs to indicate that the action is limited by circumstances or defined by conditions. In<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>
            <itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">κε</itype>is four times as common as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν,</foreign>in Lyr. about equally common. No clear distinction can be traced, but<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">κε</itype>as an enclitic is somewhat less emphatic;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>is preferred by<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>in negative clauses,<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">κε</itype>(<etym lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="etym">ν</etym>) with the relative.</sense>
          <sense n="A" id="n6207.1" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense">In Simple Sentences, and in the Apodosis of Compound Sentences; here<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>belongs to the Verb, and denotes that the assertion made by the Verb is dependent on a condition, expressed or implied: thus<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἦλθεν</foreign>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">he came,</tr>
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἦλθεν ἄν</foreign>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">he would have come</tr>(under conditions, which may or may not be defined), and so<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">he might have come;</tr>
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἔλθοι</foreign>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">may he come,</tr>
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἔλθοι ἄν</foreign>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">he would come</tr>(under certain conditions), and so<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">he might come.</tr>
          </sense>
          <sense n="I" id="n6207.2" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">WITH INDICATIVE:</sense>
          <sense n="1" id="n6207.3" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">with historical tenses, generally<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">impf.</tns>and<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">aor.</tns>, less freq.<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">plpf.</tns>, never<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">pf.</tns>,<abbr TEIform="abbr">v.</abbr>infr.,</sense>
          <sense n="a" id="n6207.4" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">most freq. in apodosis of conditional sentences, with protasis implying nonfulfilment of a past or present condition, and apod. expressing what<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would be</tr>or<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would have been</tr>the case if the condition<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">were</tr>or<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">had been</tr>fulfilled. The<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">impf.</tns>with<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>refers to continued action, in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>always in past time, exc. perh.<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">καί κε θάμ' ἐνθάδ' ἐόντες ἐμισγόμεθ'</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:4" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:178" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">178</biblScope>
            </bibl>; later also in<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">pres.</tns>time, first in<bibl n="Thgn. 905" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Thgn.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">905</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">πολὺ ἂν θαυμαστότερον ἦν, εἰ ἐτιμῶντο</foreign>it<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would be</tr>far more strange if they were honoured,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:489a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">489a</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐκ ἂν νήσων ἐκράτει, εἰ μή τι καὶ ναυτικὸν εἶχεν</foreign>he<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would</tr>not<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">have</tr>been master of islands if he had not had also some naval power,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:9" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.9</biblScope>
            </bibl>. The<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">aor.</tns>strictly refers only to past time,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0033.tlg003.perseus-grc1:11:24" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pi.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">N.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">11.24</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ τότε ταύτην ἔσχε τὴν γνώμην, οὐδὲν ἂν ὧν νυνὶ πεποίηκεν ἔπραξεν</foreign>if he had then come to this opinion, he<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would have</tr>accomplished nothing of what he has now done,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg004.perseus-grc1:5" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.5</biblScope>
            </bibl>, al., but is used idiomatically with Verbs of saying, answering, etc., as we say<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">I should have</tr>said,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">εἰ μὴ πατὴρ ἦσθ', εἶπον ἄν ς' οὐκ εὖ φρονεῖν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg002.perseus-grc1:755" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Ant.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">755</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg011.perseus-grc1:199d" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Smp.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">199d</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg001.perseus-grc1:12d" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Euthphr.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">12d</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.: the<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">plpf.</tns>refers to completed actions, as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὃ εἰ ἀπεκρίνω, ἱκανῶς ἂν ἤδη παρὰ σοῦ τὴν ὁσιότητα ἐμεμαθήκη</foreign>I<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">should have</tr>already learnt . . , ib.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg001.perseus-grc1:14c" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">14c</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">εἰ ὁ ἀνὴρ ἀπέθανεν, δικαίως ἂν ἐτεθνήκει</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0028.tlg004.perseus-grc1:2:3" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Antipho</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.2.3</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>.</sense>
          <sense n="b" id="n6207.5" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">the protasis is freq. understood:<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὑπό κεν ταλασίφρονά περ δέος εἷλεν</foreign>fear<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would have</tr>seized even the stout-hearted (had he heard the sound),<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:4:421" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.421</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τὸ γὰρ ἔρυμα τῷ στρατοπέδῳ οὐκ ἂν ἐτειχίσαντο</foreign>they<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would</tr>not<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">have</tr>built the wall (if they had not won a battle),<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:11" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.11</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">πολλοῦ γὰρ ἂν ἦν ἄξια</foreign>for (if that were so) they<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would be</tr>worth much,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:374d" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">374d</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐ γὰρ ἦν ὅ τι ἂν ἐποιεῖτε</foreign>for there was nothing which you<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">could have</tr>done, i. e.<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would have</tr>done (if you had tried),<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg018.perseus-grc1:43" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">18.43</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="c" id="n6207.6" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">with no definite protasis understood, to express what<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would have been likely to happen,</tr>or<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">might have happened</tr>in past time:<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἢ γάρ μιν ζωόν γε κιχήσεαι, ἤ κεν Ὀρέστης κτεῖνεν ὑποφθάμενος</foreign>for either you will find him alive, or else Orestes<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">may</tr>already<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">have</tr>killed him before you,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:4:546" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.546</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὃ θεασάμενος πᾶς ἄν τις ἀνὴρ ἠράσθη δάϊος εἶναι</foreign>every man who saw this (the 'Seven against Thebes')<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would have</tr>longed to be a warrior,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg009.perseus-grc1:1022" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Ar.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Ra.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1022</biblScope>
            </bibl>; esp. with<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τάχα,</foreign>q. v.,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἀλλ' ἦλθε μὲν δὴ τοῦτο τοὔνειδος τάχ' ἂν ὀργῇ βιασθὲν μᾶλλον ἢ γνώμῃ φρενῶν,</foreign>i. e. it<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">might</tr>perhaps<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">have</tr>come,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg004.perseus-grc1:523" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">OT</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">523</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τάχα ἂν δὲ καὶ ἄλλως πως ἐσπλεύσαντες</foreign>(sc.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">διέβησαν</foreign>) and they<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">might</tr>also perhaps<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">have</tr>crossed by sea (to Sicily) in some other way,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:6:2" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">6.2</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg012:265b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Phdr.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">265b</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="d" id="n6207.7" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>is freq. omitted in apodosi with Verbs expressing obligation, propriety, or possibility, as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἔδει, ἐχρῆν, εἰκὸς ἦν,</foreign>etc., and sts. for rhetorical effect,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ μὴ . . ᾖσμεν, φόβον παρέσχεν</foreign>it<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">had</tr>caused (for it<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would have</tr>caused) fear,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg007.perseus-grc1:1113" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Hec.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1113</biblScope>
            </bibl>. This use becomes more common in later Gk.</sense>
          <sense n="2" id="n6207.8" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">with<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">fut.</tns>ind.:</sense>
          <sense n="a" id="n6207.9" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">frequently in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ep.</gram>
            </gramGrp>, usu. with<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">κεν</itype>, rarely<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν,</foreign>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:9:167" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">9.167</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:22:66" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">22.66</biblScope>
            </bibl>, indicating a limitation or condition,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ δέ κεν κεχολώσεται ὅν κεν ἵκωμαι</foreign>and he<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">will likely be</tr>angry to whom-<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">soever</tr>I shall come, ib.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:139" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.139</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">καί κέ τις ὧδ' ἐρέει</foreign>and in that case men will say,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:4:176" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.176</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἐγὼ δέ κέ τοι καταλέξω</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:3:80" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.80</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>; so in Lyr.,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">μαθὼν δέ τις ἂν ἐρεῖ</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0033.tlg003.perseus-grc1:7:68" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pi.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">N.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">7.68</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0033.tlg004.perseus-grc1:6(5).59" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">I.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">6(5).59</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="b" id="n6207.10" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">rarely in codd. of<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
            </gramGrp>Prose writers,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">σαφὲς ἂν καταστήσετε</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:140" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.140</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐχ ἥκει, οὐδ' ἂν ἥξει δεῦρο</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:615d" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">615d</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg002.perseus-grc1:29c" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Ap.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">29c</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg006.perseus-grc1:2:5:13" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">An.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.5.13</biblScope>
            </bibl>; dub. in<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0627.tlg036:2:174" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hp.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Mul.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.174</biblScope>
            </bibl>: in later Prose,<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Philostr.</author>
            </bibl>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">V A</tr>
            <bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.21</biblScope>
            </bibl>, S<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">M.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">9.225</biblScope>
            </bibl>: also in Poetry,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg012.perseus-grc1:484" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">El.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">484</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg006.perseus-grc1:1313" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Ar.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Av.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1313</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐκ ἂν προδώσω</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0650.tlg001:6:36" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Herod.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">6.36</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>(corr.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">-δοίην</foreign>):— for<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>with<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">fut.</tns>
            <mood opt="n" TEIform="mood">inf.</mood>and<mood opt="n" TEIform="mood">part.</mood>
            <abbr TEIform="abbr">v.</abbr>infr.</sense>
          <sense n="II" id="n6207.11" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">WITH SUBJUNCTIVE, only in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ep.</gram>
            </gramGrp>, the meaning being the same as with the<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">fut.</tns>ind. (<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0650.tlg001:1:2a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.2a</biblScope>
            </bibl>), freq. with<per opt="n" TEIform="per">1st pers.</per>, as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ δέ κε μὴ δώῃσιν, ἐγὼ δέ κεν αὐτὸς ἕλωμαι</foreign>in that case<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">I will</tr>take her myself,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:324" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.324</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">πείθευ, ἐγὼ δέ κέ τοι εἰδέω χάριν</foreign>obey and<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">if so</tr>I will be grateful,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:14:235" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">14.235</biblScope>
            </bibl>(the<mood opt="n" TEIform="mood">subj.</mood>is always introduced by<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">δέ</foreign>in this usage); also with other persons, giving emphasis to the future,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐκ ἄν τοι χραίσμῃ κίθαρις</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:3:54" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.54</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, al.</sense>
          <sense n="III" id="n6207.12" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">WITH OPTATIVE (never<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">fut.</tns>, rarely<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">pf.</tns>
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">πῶς ἂν λελήθοι [με</foreign>];<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg004.perseus-grc1:3:6" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Smp.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.6</biblScope>
            </bibl>):</sense>
          <sense n="a" id="n6207.13" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">in apodosis of conditional sentences, after protasis in opt. with<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ</foreign>or some other conditional or relative word, expressing a<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">fut.</tns>condition:<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἀλλ' εἴ μοί τι πίθοιο, τό κεν πολὺ κέρδιον εἴη</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:7:28" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">7.28</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐ πολλὴ ἂν ἀλογία εἴη, εἰ φοβοῖτο τὸν θάνατον;</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg004.perseus-grc1:68b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Phd.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">68b</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>:—in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>
            <tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">pres.</tns>and<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">aor.</tns>opt. with<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">κε</itype>or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>are sts. used<abbr TEIform="abbr">like</abbr>
            <tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">impf.</tns>and<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">aor.</tns>ind. with<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>in Attic, with either regular ind. or another opt. in the protasis:<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">καί νύ κεν ἔνθ' ἀπόλοιτο . . εἰ μὴ . . νόησε κτλ.,</foreign>i. e. he<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would have</tr>perished, had she not perceived, etc.,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:5:311" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.311</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:5:388" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.388</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:17:70" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">17.70</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ νῦν ἐπὶ ἄλλῳ ἀεθλεύοιμεν, ἦ τ' ἂν ἐγὼ . . κλισίηνδε φεροίμην</foreign>if we were now contending in another's honour, I<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">should</tr>now carry . . , ib.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:23:274" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">23.274</biblScope>
            </bibl>: so rarely in Trag.,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐδ' ἂν σὺ φαίης, εἴ σε μὴ κνίζοι λέχος</foreign>(for<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ μὴ ἔκνιζε</foreign>)<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg003.perseus-grc1:568" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Med.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">568</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="b" id="n6207.14" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">with protasis in<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">pres.</tns>or<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">fut.</tns>, the opt. with<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>in apodosi takes a simply future sense:<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">φρούριον δ' εἰ ποιήσονται, τῆς μὲν γῆς βλάπτοιεν ἄν τι μέρος</foreign>they<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">might perhaps</tr>damage,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:142" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.142</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:2:60" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.60</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg002.perseus-grc1:25b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Ap.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">25b</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:333e" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">333e</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἢν οὖν μάθῃς . . οὐκ ἂν ἀποδοίην</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg003.perseus-grc1:116" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Ar.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Nu.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">116</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg001.perseus-grc1:26" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.26</biblScope>
            </bibl>, al.</sense>
          <sense n="c" id="n6207.15" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">with protasis understood:<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">φεύγωμεν: ἔτι γάρ κεν ἀλύξαιμεν κακὸν ἦμαρ</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:10:269" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">10.269</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὔτε ἐσθίουσι πλείω ἢ δύνανται φέρειν: διαρραγεῖεν γὰρ ἄν</foreign>for (if they should do so) they<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would</tr>burst,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg007.perseus-grc1:8:2:21" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Cyr.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">8.2.21</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τὸν δ' οὔ κε δύ' ἀνέρε . . ἀπ' οὔδεος ὀχλίσσειαν</foreign>two men<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">could</tr>not heave the stone from the ground, i. e.<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would</tr>not, if they should try,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:12:447" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">12.447</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐδ' ἂν δικαίως ἐς κακὸν πέσοιμί τι</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg002.perseus-grc1:240" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Ant.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">240</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg002.perseus-grc1:8" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.8</biblScope>
            </bibl>: in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>sts. with ref. to past time,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">Τυδεί̈δην οὐκ ἂν γνοίης ποτέροισι μετείη</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:5:85" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.85</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>.</sense>
          <sense n="d" id="n6207.16" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">with no definite protasis implied, in potential sense:<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἡδέως δ' ἂν ἐροίμην Λεπτίνην</foreign>but I<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would</tr>gladly ask Leptines,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg020.perseus-grc1:129" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">20.129</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">βουλοίμην ἄν</foreign>I<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">should</tr>
            <abbr TEIform="abbr">like</abbr>, Lat.<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">velim</tr>(but<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐβουλόμην ἄν</foreign>I<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">should</tr>wish, if it were of any avail,<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">vellem</tr>);<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ποῖ οὖν τραποίμεθ' ἄν;</foreign>which way then<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">can</tr>we turn?<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg021:290a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Euthd.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">290a</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐκ ἂν μεθείμην τοῦ θρόνου</foreign>I<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">will</tr>not give up the throne,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg009.perseus-grc1:830" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Ar.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Ra.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">830</biblScope>
            </bibl>; idiomatically, referring to the past,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">αὗται δὲ οὐκ ἂν πολλαὶ εἶεν</foreign>but these<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would</tr>not (on investigation) prove to be many,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:9" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.9</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἴησαν δ' ἂν οὗτοι Κρῆτες</foreign>these<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would</tr>be (i. e.<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would have</tr>been) Cretans,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:2" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hdt.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.2</biblScope>
            </bibl>: used in order to soften assertions by giving them a less positive form, as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐκ ἂν οὖν πάνυ γέ τι σπουδαῖον εἴη ἡ δικαιοσύνη,</foreign>i.e. it<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would</tr>not<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">prove to be,</tr>etc. (for, it<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">is</tr>not, etc.),<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
            </bibl>
            <pb n="97" TEIform="pb"/>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:333e" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">333e</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="e" id="n6207.17" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">in questions, expressing a wish:<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τίς ἂν θεῶν . . δοίη;</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg007.perseus-grc1:1100" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">OC</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1100</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg005.perseus-grc1:1448" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Ag.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1448</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">πῶς ἂν θάνοιμι;</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg003.perseus-grc1:389" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Aj.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">389</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>: hence (with no question) as a mild command, exhortation, or entreaty,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τλαίης κεν Μενελάῳ ἐπιπροέμεν ταχὺν ἰόν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:4:94" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.94</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">σὺ μὲν κομίζοις ἂν σεαυτὸν ᾗ θέλεις</foreign>you<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">may</tr>take yourself off (milder than<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">κόμιζε σεαυτόν</foreign>),<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg002.perseus-grc1:444" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Ant.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">444</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">χωροῖς ἂν εἴσω</foreign>you<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">may</tr>go in,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg005.perseus-grc1:1491" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">El.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1491</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">κλύοις ἂν ἤδη, Φοῖβε</foreign>hear me now, Phoebus, ib.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg005.perseus-grc1:637" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">637</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">φράζοις ἄν, λέγοις ἄν,</foreign>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg010:23c" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Phlb.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">23c</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg010:48b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">48b</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="f" id="n6207.18" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">in a protasis which is also an apodosis:<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἴπερ ἄλλῳ τῳ ἀνθρώπων πειθοίμην ἄν, καὶ σοὶ πείθομαι</foreign>if I<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would</tr>trust any (other) man (if he gave me his word), I trust you,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg022:329b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Prt.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">329b</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ μὴ ποιήσαιτ' ἂν τοῦτο</foreign>if you<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would</tr>not do this (if you could),<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg004.perseus-grc1:18" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.18</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg002.perseus-grc1:1:5:3" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Mem.</title>

          <sense n="B" id="n6207.32" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense">IN DEPENDENT CLAUSE<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

          <sense n="I" id="n6207.33" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">In the protasis of conditional sentences with<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ,</foreign>regularly with the subjunctive. In Attic<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ ἄν</foreign>is contracted into<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐάν, ἤν,</foreign>or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>(<etym lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="etym">ᾱ</etym>) (q. v.):<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>has generally<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἴ κε</foreign>(or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">αἴ κε</foreign>), sts.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἤν,</foreign>once<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">εἰ δ' ἄν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:3:288" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.288</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, twice<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">εἴπερ ἄν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:5:224" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.224</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:232" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">232</biblScope>
            </bibl>. The protasis expresses either future condition (with apod. of<tns opt="n" TEIform="tns">fut.</tns>time) or general condition (with apod. of repeated action):<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ δέ κεν ὣς ἔρξῃς καί τοι πείθωνται Ἀχαιοί, γνώσῃ ἔπειθ' ὅς</foreign>. . if thus thou shalt do . . , ib.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:2:364" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.364</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἢν ἐγγὺς ἔλθῃ θάνατος, οὐδεὶς βούλεται θνῄσκειν</foreign>if death (ever) come near . . ,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg002.perseus-grc1:671" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Alc.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">671</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="2" id="n6207.34" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">in relative or temporal clauses with a conditional force; here<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>coalesces with<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅτε, ὁπότε, ἐπεί, ἐπειδή,</foreign>cf.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅταν, ὁπόταν, ἐπήν</foreign>or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐπάν</foreign>(<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ion.</gram>
            </gramGrp>
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐπεάν</foreign>)<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">, ἐπειδάν</foreign>:<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>has<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅτε κε</foreign>(sts.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅτ' ἄν</foreign>)<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">, ὁππότε κε</foreign>(sts.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁπότ' ἄν</foreign>or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁππότ' ἄν</foreign>)<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">, ἐπεί κε</foreign>(<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἐπεὶ ἄν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:6:412" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">6.412</biblScope>
              </bibl>

            <abbr TEIform="abbr">v.</abbr>also<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰσόκε</foreign>(<etym lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="etym">εἰς ὅ κε</etym>) :<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">—τάων ἥν κ' ἐθέλωμι φίλην ποιήσομ' ἄκοιτιν</foreign>whomsoever of these I<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">may</tr>wish . . ,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:9:397" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

          <sense n="I" id="n6207.44" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">POSITION OF<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν.</foreign>
          </sense>
          <sense n="1" id="n6207.45" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">in A, when<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>does not coalesce with the relat. word (as in<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐάν, ὅταν</foreign>), it follows directly or is separated only by other particles, as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">μέν, δέ,<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">τε</itype>, γάρ, καί,<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">νυ</itype>,<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">περ</itype>,</foreign>etc.; as<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">εἰ μέν κεν . . εἰ δέ κε</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:3:281" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.281</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>-<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:4" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4</biblScope>
            </bibl>; rarely by<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">τις</itype>, as<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ὅποι τις ἄν, οἶμαι, προσθῇ</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg002.perseus-grc1:14" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.14</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>:—in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>and<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hes.</author>
            </bibl>two such Particles may precede<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">κε</itype>, as<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">εἴ περ γάρ κεν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:8:355" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">8.355</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:2:123" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.123</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰ γάρ τίς κε, ὃς μὲν γάρ κε,</foreign>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0020.tlg002.perseus-grc1:280" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hes.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Op.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">280</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0020.tlg002.perseus-grc1:357" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">357</biblScope>
            </bibl>; rarely in Prose,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ὅποι μὲν γὰρ ἄν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg004.perseus-grc1:45" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.45</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ὁπότερος οὖν ἄν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg009.perseus-grc1:1420" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Ar.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Ra.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1420</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>: also<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ὁπόσῳ πλέον ἄν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg034.perseus-grc1:647e" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Lg.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">647e</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg034.perseus-grc1:850a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">850a</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ὅπου τὸ πάλαι λεγόμενον ἂν γίγνηται</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg034.perseus-grc1:739c" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">739c</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>.</sense>
          <sense n="2" id="n6207.46" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">in apodosis,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>may stand either next to its Verb (before or after it), or after some other emphatic word, esp. an interrog., a negative (e. g.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐδ' ἂν εἷς, οὐκ ἂν ἔτι,</foreign>etc.), or an important Adjective or Adverb; also after a participle which represents the protasis,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">λέγοντος ἄν τινος πιστεῦσαι οἴεσθε;</foreign>do you think they<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">would have</tr>believed it if any one had told them? (<etym lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="etym">εἴ τις ἔλεγεν, ἐπίστευσαν ἄν</etym>),<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg006.perseus-grc1:20" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">6.20</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="3" id="n6207.47" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>is freq. separated from its<mood opt="n" TEIform="mood">inf.</mood>by such Verbs as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οἴομαι, δοκέω, φημί, οἶδα,</foreign>etc.,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐκ ἂν οἴει</foreign>. . ; freq. in<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg023:486d" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>,<title TEIform="title">Grg.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">486d</biblScope>
            </bibl>, al.;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">καὶ νῦν ἡδέως ἄν μοι δοκῶ κοινωνῆσαι</foreign>I think that I<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">should,</tr>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg007.perseus-grc1:8:7:25" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Cyr.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">8.7.25</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὕτω γὰρ ἄν μοι δοκεῖ ἥ τε πόλις ἄριστα διοικεῖσθαι</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0026.tlg003.perseus-grc1:2" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Aeschin.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.2</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἃ μήτε προῄδει μηδεὶς μήτ' ἂν ᾠήθη τήμερον ῥηθῆναι</foreign>(where<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>belongs to<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ῥηθῆναι</foreign>)<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg018.perseus-grc1:225" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">18.225</biblScope>
            </bibl>:—in the phrase<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐκ οἶδ' ἂν εἰ,</foreign>or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐκ ἂν οἶδ' εἰ, ἄν</foreign>belongs not to<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οἶδα,</foreign>but to the Verb which follows,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐκ οἶδ' ἂν εἰ πείσαιμι,</foreign>for<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὐκ οἶδα εἰ πείσαιμι ἄν,</foreign>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg003.perseus-grc1:941" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Med.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">941</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg002.perseus-grc1:48" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Alc.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">48</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐκ ἂν οἶδ' εἰ δυναίμην</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg031:26b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Ti.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">26b</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐκ οἶδ' ἂν εἰ ἐκτησάμην</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg007.perseus-grc1:5:4:12" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Cyr.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.4.12</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>.</sense>
          <sense n="4" id="n6207.48" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>never begins a sentence, or even a clause after a comma, but may stand first after a parenthetic clause,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἀλλ', ὦ μέλ', ἄν μοι σιτίων διπλῶν ἔδει</quote>
              <bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Ar.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Pax</title>
              </bibl>
            </cit><*><bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg005.perseus-grc1:37" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">37</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="II" id="n6207.49" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">REPETITION OF<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>:—in apodosis<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>may be used twice or even three times with the same Verb, either to make the condition felt throughout a long sentence, or to emphasize certain words,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ὥστ' ἄν, εἰ σθένος λάβοιμι, δηλώσαιμ' ἄν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg005.perseus-grc1:333" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">El.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">333</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg002.perseus-grc1:69" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Ant.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">69</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg005.perseus-grc1:340" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Ag.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">340</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:76" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.76</biblScope>
            </bibl>(fin.),<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:2:41" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.41</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg002.perseus-grc1:31a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Ap.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">31a</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0540.tlg020.perseus-grc1:15" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Lys.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">20.15</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἀφανεῖς ἂν ὄντες οὐκ ἂν ὑμνήθημεν ἄν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg011.perseus-grc1:1244" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Tr.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1244</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg008.perseus-grc1:739" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Fr.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">739</biblScope>
            </bibl>; attached to a parenthetical phrase,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἔδρας' ἄν, εὖ τοῦτ' ἴσθ' ἄν, εἰ</foreign>. .<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg004.perseus-grc1:1438" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">OT</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1438</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="2" id="n6207.50" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>is coupled with<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">κε</itype>(<etym lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="etym">ν</etym>) a few times in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>, as<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:11:187" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">11.187</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:202" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">202</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:5:361" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.361</biblScope>
            </bibl>, al.; cf.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἤν περ γάρ κ' ἐθέλωσιν</foreign>
            <abbr TEIform="abbr">v.l.</abbr>ib.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:18:318" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">18.318</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="III" id="n6207.51" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">ELLIPSIS OF VERB:—sts. the Verb to which<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>belongs must be supplied, in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>only<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰμί,</foreign>as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τάτ' ἔλδεται ὅς κ' ἐπιδευής</foreign>(sc.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ᾖ</foreign>)<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:5:481" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.481</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἀλλ' οὐκ ἂν πρὸ τοῦ</foreign>(sc.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἔρρεγκον</foreign>)<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg003.perseus-grc1:5" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Ar.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Nu.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τί δ' ἂν δοκεῖ σοι Πρίαμος</foreign>(sc.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">πρᾶξαι</foreign>)<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">, εἰ τάδ' ἤνυσεν;</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg005.perseus-grc1:935" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Ag.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">935</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>:—so in phrases<xr opt="n" TEIform="xr">
              <lbl opt="n" TEIform="lbl">like</lbl>
              <ref targOrder="U" lang="greek" TEIform="ref">πῶς γὰρ ἄν</ref>
            </xr>; and<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">πῶς οὐκ ἄν</foreign>(sc.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἴη</foreign>); also in<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὥσπερ ἂν εἰ</foreign>(or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὡσπερανεί</foreign>), as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">φοβούμενος ὥσπερ ἂν εἰ παῖς</foreign>(i. e.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὥσπερ ἂν ἐφοβήθη εἰ παῖς ἦν</foreign>)<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg023:479a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Grg.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">479a</biblScope>
            </bibl>; so<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοσοῦτον ἐφρόνησαν, ὅσον περ ἂν</foreign>(sc.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐφρόνησαν</foreign>)<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">εἰ . .</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0010.tlg009.perseus-grc1:48" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Isoc.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">10.48</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>:—so also when<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">κἂν εἰ</foreign>(<xr opt="n" TEIform="xr">
              <lbl opt="n" TEIform="lbl">=</lbl>
              <ref targOrder="U" lang="greek" TEIform="ref">καὶ ἂν εἰ</ref>
            </xr>) has either no Verb in the apod. or one to which<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>cannot belong,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:477a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">477a</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg024:72c" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Men.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">72c</biblScope>
            </bibl>; cf.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">κἄν</foreign>:—so the Verb of a protasis containing<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>may be understood,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅποι τις ἂν προσθῇ, κἂν μικρὰν δύναμιν</foreign>(i. e.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">καὶ ἐὰν προσθῇ</foreign>)<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg002.perseus-grc1:14" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.14</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὡς ἐμοῦ οὖν ἰόντος ὅπῃ ἂν καὶ ὑμεῖς</foreign>(sc.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἴητε</foreign>)<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg006.perseus-grc1:1:3:6" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">An.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.3.6</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="IV" id="n6207.52" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">ELLIPSIS OF<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>:—when an apodosis consists of several co-ordinate clauses,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>is generally used only in the first and understood in the others:<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">πείθοι' ἂν εἰ πείθοι': ἀπειθοίης δ' ἴσως</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg005.perseus-grc1:1049" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Ag.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1049</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>: even when the construction is continued in a new sentence,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:352e" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">352e</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:439b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">439b</biblScope>
            </bibl>codd.: but<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄν</foreign>is repeated for the sake of clearness or emphasis, ib.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:398a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">398a</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg019.perseus-grc1:156" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">19.156</biblScope>

              <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">9.393</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἴ που πτωχῶν γε θεοὶ . . εἰσίν</foreign>if the poor<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">have</tr>any gods to care for them,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:17:475" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

              </bibl>

              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>

<entryFree id="n31235" key="εἰς" type="main" opt="n" TEIform="entryFree">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="orth">εἰς</orth>or<orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="orth">ἐς</orth>, PREP. WITH ACC. ONLY:—both forms are found in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

            <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ion.</gram>

            <author TEIform="author">Hdt.</author>
          </bibl>and<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

            <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">7.235.1</biblScope>

(exc. in parody): Trag. apptly. prefer<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">εἰς</foreign>, but<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐς</foreign>is used before vowels metri gr.;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐς</foreign>was retained in the phrases<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐς κόρακας</foreign>(whence the Verb<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">σκορακίζω</foreign>)<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">, ἐς μακαρίαν</foreign>.<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">

<entryFree id="n71881" key="Ο" type="main" opt="n" TEIform="entryFree">

<entryFree id="n71882" key="ὁ1" type="main" opt="n" TEIform="entryFree">
          <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="orth">ὁ</orth>,<orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="orth">ἡ</orth>,<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">τό</gen>, is, when thus written,<sense n="A" id="n71882.0" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense">demonstr. Pronoun.</sense>
          <sense n="B" id="n71882.1" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense">in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
            </gramGrp>, definite or prepositive Article.</sense>
          <sense n="C" id="n71882.2" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense">in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ep.</gram>
            </gramGrp>, the so-called postpositive Article,<abbr TEIform="abbr">=</abbr>relative Pronoun,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅς, ἥ, ὅ.</foreign>—The nom. masc. and fem. sg. and pl.,<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">ὁ</gen>,<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">ἡ</gen>,<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">οἱ</gen>,<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">αἱ</gen>, have no accent in codd. and most printed books, exc. when used as the relative ; but<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">ὁ</gen>,<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">ἡ</gen>,<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">οἱ</gen>
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">, αἱ</foreign>differ only in writing from<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὃ, ἣ, οἳ, αἳ</foreign>; the nom. forms of the article are said by Hdn.Gr.<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.474</biblScope>
            </bibl>to be oxytone, and by<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0082.tlg001:8:7" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">A.D.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Pron.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">8.7</biblScope>
            </bibl>not to be enclitic. The forms<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τῶν, τοῖς, ταῖς</foreign>were barytone (i. e.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τὼν, τοὶς, ταὶς</foreign>) in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Aeol.</gram>
            </gramGrp>acc. to<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Aristarch.</author>
            </bibl>ap.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0082.tlg004:51:26" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">A.D.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Synt.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">51.26</biblScope>
            </bibl>. For<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">οἱ</gen>
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">, αἱ</foreign>some dialects (not<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Cypr.</author>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Inscr.Cypr.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">135.30H.</biblScope>
            </bibl>, nor Cret., cf.<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Leg.Gort.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.28</biblScope>
            </bibl>, nor Lesbian, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0383.tlg001:81" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Alc.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">81</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0009.tlg001:5:1" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Sapph.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Supp.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.1</biblScope>
            </bibl>) and<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>have<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοί, ταί</foreign>(though<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">οἱ</gen>
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">, αἱ</foreign>are also found in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>) : other Homeric forms<pb n="1194" TEIform="pb"/>are gen. sg.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοῖο,</foreign>gen. and dat. dual<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τοῖιν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:18:34" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">18.34</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, al. : gen. pl. fem.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τάων<pron extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="pron">[ᾱ]</pron>,</foreign>dat.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοῖσι, τῇς</foreign>and<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τῇσι,</foreign>never<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ταῖσι</foreign>or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ταῖς</foreign>in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>— In<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Dor.</gram>
            </gramGrp>and all other dialects exc.<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
            </gramGrp>and<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ion.</gram>
            </gramGrp>the fem. forms preserve the old<pron extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="pron">ᾱ</pron>instead of changing it to<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">η,</itype>hence<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Dor.</gram>
            </gramGrp>etc.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἁ, τάν, τᾶς</foreign>; the gen. pl.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τάων</foreign>contracts in many dialects to<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τᾶν</foreign>; the gen. sg. is in many places<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τῶ,</foreign>acc. pl.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τώς,</foreign>but Cret., etc.,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τόνς</foreign>(<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Leg.Gort.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">7.7</biblScope>
            </bibl>, al.) or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τός</foreign>(ib.<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.50</biblScope>
            </bibl>, al.) ; in Lesbian<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Aeol.</gram>
            </gramGrp>the acc. pl. forms are<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοὶς, ταὶς,</foreign>
            <bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">IG</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">12(2).645</biblScope>
            </bibl>
            <bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">A</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">13</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">B</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">62</biblScope>
            </bibl>; dat. pl.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοῖς, ταῖς</foreign>(or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοὶς, ταὶς,</foreign>
            <abbr TEIform="abbr">v.</abbr>supr.), ib.<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">645</biblScope>
            </bibl>
            <bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">A</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">8</biblScope>
            </bibl>, ib.<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.6</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ταῖσι</foreign>as demonstr.,<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Sapph.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">16</biblScope>
            </bibl>. The<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
            </gramGrp>Poets also used the<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ion.</gram>
            </gramGrp>and<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ep.</gram>
            </gramGrp>forms<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοῖσι, ταῖσι</foreign>; and in Trag. we find<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοὶ μέν . . , τοὶ δέ . . ,</foreign>for<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οἱ μέν . . , οἱ δέ . . ,</foreign>not only in lyr., as<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg002.perseus-grc1:584" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Pers.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">584</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg004.perseus-grc1:295" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Th.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">295</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg004.perseus-grc1:298" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">298</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οἱ μέν . . τοὶ δ'</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg003.perseus-grc1:1404" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Aj.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1404</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>(anap.) ; but even in a trimeter,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg002.perseus-grc1:424" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Pers.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">424</biblScope>
            </bibl>. In<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
            </gramGrp>the dual has usu. only one gender,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τὼ θεώ</foreign>(for<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τὰ θεά</foreign>)<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0027.tlg001.perseus-grc1:113" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">And.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.113</biblScope>
            </bibl>sq. ;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τὼ πόλεε</foreign>Foed. ap.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:5:23" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.23</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τὼ ἡμέρα</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg007.perseus-grc1:1:2:11" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

                <title TEIform="title">Cyr.</title>
