              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τοῖν πολέοιν</quote>

              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τοὺς μὲν τὰ δίκαια ποιεῖν ἠνάγκασα, τοὺς πλουσίους, τοὺς δὲ πένητας κτλ.</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg018.perseus-grc1:102" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">18.102</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg023:501a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Grg.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">501a</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.</sense>
          <sense n="2" id="n71882.10" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">when a neg. accompanies<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ δέ,</foreign>it follows<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">δέ,</foreign>e.g.<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τὰς γοῦν Ἀθήνας οἶδα τὸν δὲ χῶρον οὔ</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg007.perseus-grc1:24" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">OC</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">24</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τὸν φιλόσοφον σοφίας ἐπιθυμητὴν εἶναι, οὐ τῆς μὲν τῆς δ' οὔ, ἀλλὰ πάσης</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:475b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">475b</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐ πάσας χρὴ τὰς δόξας τιμᾶν, ἀλλὰ τὰς μὲν τὰς δ' οὔ: οὐδὲ πάντων, ἀλλὰ τῶν μὲν τῶν δ' οὔ</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg003.perseus-grc1:47a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Cri.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">47a</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, etc.</sense>
          <sense n="3" id="n71882.11" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ μέν τις . . , ὁ δέ τις . .</foreign>is used in Prose, when the Noun to which<gen lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="gen">ὁ</gen>refers is left indefinite,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἔλεγον ὁ μέν τις τὴν σοφίαν, ὁ δὲ τὴν καρτερίαν . . , ὁ δέ τις καὶ τὸ κάλλος</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg007.perseus-grc1:3:1:41" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Cyr.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.1.41</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">νόμους . . τοὺς μὲν ὀρθῶς τιθέασιν τοὺς δέ τινας οὐκ ὀρθῶς</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:339c" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">339c</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg010:13c" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Phlb.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">13c</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="4" id="n71882.12" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">on<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τὸ μέν . . , τὸ δέ . . ,</foreign>or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τὰ μέν . . , τὰ δέ . . ,</foreign>
            <abbr TEIform="abbr">v.</abbr>infr. VIII.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg010:4" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="5" id="n71882.13" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ μέν</foreign>is freq. used without a corresponding<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ὁ δέ, οἱ μὲν ἄρ' ἐσκίδναντο . . , Μυρμιδόνας δ' οὐκ εἴα ἀποσκίδνασθαι</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:23:3" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">23.3</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:24:722" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">24.722</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:8:12" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">8.12</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.: also folld. by<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἀλλά, ἡ μὲν γάρ μ' ἐκέλευε . . , ἀλλ' ἐγὼ οὐκ ἔθελον</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:7:304" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">7.304</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>; by<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἄλλος δέ,</foreign>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:6:147" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">6.147</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc. ;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τὸν μὲν . . , ἕτερον δέ</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg006.perseus-grc1:843" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Ar.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Av.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">843</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, etc. ;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ὁ μέν . . , ὃς δέ . .</quote>
              <bibl n="Thgn. 205" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Thgn.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">205</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>(<xr opt="n" TEIform="xr">
              <lbl opt="n" TEIform="lbl">v.l.</lbl>
              <ref targOrder="U" lang="greek" TEIform="ref">οὐδέ</ref>
            </xr>) : less freq.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ δέ</foreign>in the latter clause without<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ μέν</foreign>preceding,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τῇ ῥα παραδραμέτην φεύγων, ὁ δ' ὄπισθε διώκων</foreign>(for<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ μὲν φεύγων</foreign>)<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:22:157" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">22.157</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">σφραγῖδε . . χρυσοῦν ἔχουσα τὸν δακτύλιον, ἡ δ' ἑτέρα ἀργυροῦν</quote>
              <bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <title TEIform="title">IG</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">22.1388.45</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">μέν</quote>
              <bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              </bibl>
            </cit>III ;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">γεωργὸς μὲν εἷς, ὁ δὲ οἰκοδόμος, ἄλλος δέ τις ὑφαντής</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:369d" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">369d</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg006.perseus-grc1:181d" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Tht.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">181d</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="6" id="n71882.14" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ δέ</foreign>following<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">μέν</foreign>sts. refers to the subject of the preceding clause,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τοῦ μὲν ἅμαρθ', ὁ δὲ Λεῦκον . . βεβλήκει</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:4:491" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.491</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τὴν μὲν γενομένην αὐτοῖσι αἰτίην οὐ μάλα ἐξέφαινε, ὁ δὲ ἔλεγέ σφι</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:6:3" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Hdt.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">6.3</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:66" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.66</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:6:9" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">6.9</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:133" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">133</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:7:6" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">7.6</biblScope>
            </bibl>: rare in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
            </gramGrp>Prose,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἐπεψήφιζεν αὐτὸς ἔφορος ὤν: ὁ δὲ οὐκ ἔφη διαγιγνώσκειν τὴν βοήν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:87" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.87</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἔμενον ὡς κατέχοντες τὸ ἄκρον: οἱ δ' οὐ κατεῖχον</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg006.perseus-grc1:4:2:6" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">An.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.2.6</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>: this is different from<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ δέ</foreign>in apodosi,<abbr TEIform="abbr">v.</abbr>infr.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg006.perseus-grc1:7" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">7</biblScope>
            </bibl>; also from passages in which both clauses have a common verb,<xr opt="n" TEIform="xr">
              <lbl opt="n" TEIform="lbl">v.</lbl>
              <ref targOrder="U" lang="greek" TEIform="ref">ὅ γε</ref>
            </xr>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg006.perseus-grc1:11" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">11</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="7" id="n71882.15" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ δέ</foreign>is freq. used simply in continuing a narrative,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:43" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.43</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.; also used by<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hom.</author>
            </bibl>in apodosi after a relat.,<xr opt="n" TEIform="xr">
              <lbl opt="n" TEIform="lbl">v.</lbl>
              <ref targOrder="U" lang="greek" TEIform="ref">ὅδε</ref>
            </xr>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0013.tlg001.perseus-grc1:111:3" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">111.3</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="8" id="n71882.16" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">the opposition may be expressed otherwise than by<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">μέν</foreign>and<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">δέ, οὔθ' ὁ . . οὔθ' ὁ</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:15:417" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">15.417</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἢ τοῖσιν ἢ τοῖς</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg001.perseus-grc1:439" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Supp.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">439</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὔτε τοῖς οὔτε τοῖς</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg034.perseus-grc1:701e" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Lg.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">701e</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>.</sense>
          <sense n="VII" id="n71882.17" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">the following usages prevailed in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
            </gramGrp>Prose,</sense>
          <sense n="1" id="n71882.18" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">in dialogue, after<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">καί,</foreign>it was usual to say in nom. sg. masc.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">καὶ ὅς</foreign>; in the other cases the usual forms of the Art. were used (v.<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ὅς</quote>
              <bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
              </bibl>
            </cit>II.I and cf. Skt.<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">sas,</tr>alternat. form of<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">sa</tr>) ; so, in acc.,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">καὶ τὸν εἰπεῖν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg011.perseus-grc1:174a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Smp.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">174a</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg007.perseus-grc1:1:3:9" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Cyr.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.3.9</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.; also in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hdt.</author>
            </bibl>,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">καὶ τὴν φράσαι</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:6:61" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">6.61</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, al.</sense>
          <sense n="2" id="n71882.19" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ καὶ ὁ</foreign>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">such and such,</tr>
            <cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τῇ καὶ τῇ ἀτιμίᾳ</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg034.perseus-grc1:721b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Lg.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">721b</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>: but mostly in acc.,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">καί μοι κάλει τὸν καὶ τόν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0540.tlg001.perseus-grc1:23" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Lys.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.23</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg034.perseus-grc1:784d" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Lg.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">784d</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τὰ καὶ τὰ πεπονθώς</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg021.perseus-grc1:141" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">21.141</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg009.perseus-grc1:68" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">9.68</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τὸ καὶ τό</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg018.perseus-grc1:243" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">18.243</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἀνάγκη ἄρα τὸ καὶ τό</foreign>it must then be<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">so and so,</tr>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0086.tlg038.perseus-grc1:1401a:4" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Arist.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Rh.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1401a4</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0086.tlg038.perseus-grc1:1413a:22" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1413a22</biblScope>
            </bibl>; but<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τὰ καὶ τά</foreign>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">now one thing, now another,</tr>of good and bad,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τὸν δ' ἀγαθὸν τολμᾶν χρὴ τά τε καὶ τὰ φέρειν</quote>
              <bibl n="Thgn. 398" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Thgn.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">398</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0033.tlg002.perseus-grc1:5:55" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pi.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">P.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.55</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0033.tlg002.perseus-grc1:7:20" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">7.20</biblScope>
            </bibl>, al.;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τῶν τε καὶ τῶν καιρόν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0033.tlg001.perseus-grc1:2:53" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">O.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.53</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>; so<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">πάντα τοῦ μετρίου μεταβαλλόμενα ἐπὶ τὰ καὶ ἐπὶ τά,</foreign>of excess and defect,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0627.tlg004.perseus-grc1:46" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hp.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Acut.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">46</biblScope>
            </bibl>; cf.<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
            </bibl>VI.<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

          <sense n="B" id="n71882.34" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense">

          <sense n="I" id="n71882.35" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">not only with common Appellats., Adjs., and Parts., to specify them as present to sense or mind, but also freq. where we use the Possessive Pron.,<cit TEIform="cit">

          <sense n="b" id="n71882.36" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">omitted with pr.nn.and freq. with Appellats. which require no specification, as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">θεός, βασιλεύς,</foreign>

          <sense n="c" id="n71882.37" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">Aristotle says<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">Σωκράτης</foreign>meaning the historical Socrates, as in<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

            </bibl>(Chios,<date TEIform="date">iv B. C.</date>),<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">46.7</biblScope>

              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
            </gramGrp>
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>was freq. strengthd. by the demonstr.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">-ί, οὑτοσί, αὑτηί, τουτί</foreign>, gen.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τουτουί</foreign>, dat.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τουτῳί</foreign>, acc.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τουτονί</foreign>; pl. nom.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὑτοιί</foreign>, neut.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ταυτί</foreign>, etc.,<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">this man here</tr>: sts. a Particle is inserted between the Pron. and<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">-ί</foreign>, as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">αὑτηγί</foreign>for<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">αὑτηί γε</foreign>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg001.perseus-grc1:784" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg006.perseus-grc1:894" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Av.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">894</biblScope>
            </bibl>, al.;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ταυταγί</foreign>for<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ταυτί γε</foreign>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg002.perseus-grc1:492" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>

              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">82.11</biblScope>
            </bibl>. [This<itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">ι</itype>is always long, and a long vowel or diphthong before it becomes short, as<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">αὑτη̆ί, τουτῳ̆ί, οὑτοῐί</foreign>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg003.perseus-grc1:201" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

          <sense n="B" id="n76062.2" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense">USAGE in regard to CONCOR<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
            </bibl>
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>is freq. used as a Pron.<pos opt="n" TEIform="pos">Subst.</pos>: hence neut. is folld. by gen.,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">κατὰ τοῦτο τῆς ἀκροπόλιος</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:84" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Hdt.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.84</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">εἰς τοῦθ' ὕβρεως ἐλήλυθεν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg004.perseus-grc1:37" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.37</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">εἰς τοῦθ' ἥκεις μανίας</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg036.perseus-grc1:48" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">36.48</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ταῦτα τῶν μαθημάτων</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg021:278b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Euthd.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">278b</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>: but quite as freq. as<pos opt="n" TEIform="pos">Adj.</pos>, in which case its<pos opt="n" TEIform="pos">Subst.</pos>commonly takes the Art.,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος ὁ ἀνήρ</foreign>or<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ ἀνὴρ οὗτος</foreign>.—But the Art. is absent,</sense>
          <sense n="1" id="n76062.3" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">always in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ep.</gram>
            </gramGrp>Poets (exc.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:18:114" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">18.114</biblScope>
            </bibl>),<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὗτος ἀνήρ</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:14:471" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">14.471</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:1:406" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.406</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.: sts. also in Trag.,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg002.perseus-grc1:122" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Pers.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">122</biblScope>
            </bibl>(lyr.),<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg002.perseus-grc1:495" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">495</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg006.perseus-grc1:406" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Ph.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">406</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg007.perseus-grc1:471" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">OC</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">471</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg007.perseus-grc1:1177" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1177</biblScope>
            </bibl>: once in an Inscr.,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοπεῖα</foreign>:<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τούτων τὰ ἡμίσεα τοπείων</quote>
              <bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <title TEIform="title">IG</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">22.1622.135</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>
            <date TEIform="date">(iv B. C.)</date>.</sense>
          <sense n="2" id="n76062.4" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">sts. when the Noun is so specified that the Art. is not needed,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ἐς γῆν ταύτην . . , ἥντινα νῦν Σκύθαι νέμονται</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:4:8" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Hdt.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.8</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ταύτας ἃς οἱ πατέρες παρέδοσαν μελέτας</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:85" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.85</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg030.perseus-grc1:449d" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">R.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">449d</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">πατὴρ σὸς οὗτος, ὃν θρηνεῖς ἀεί</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg005.perseus-grc1:530" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">El.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">530</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>.</sense>
          <sense n="3" id="n76062.5" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">when<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>is used in local sense,<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">here</tr>,<abbr TEIform="abbr">v.</abbr>infr. c.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg005.perseus-grc1:1:5" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.5</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="4" id="n76062.6" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">when the Noun with which<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>agrees stands as its Predicate,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">αὕτη γὰρ ἦν σοι πρόφασις</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg006.perseus-grc1:1034" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Ph.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1034</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">δικαστοῦ αὕτη ἀρετή [ἐστι</foreign>]<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg002.perseus-grc1:18a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Ap.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">18a</biblScope>
            </bibl>: this exception extends to cases in which the Predicate is not so distinctly separated from the Subject,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">αἰτίαι μὲν αὗται προυγεγένηντο</foreign>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">these</tr>were the grievances which already existed,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:66" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.66</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ταύτην φήμην παρέδοσαν</foreign>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">this</tr>was the report which . . ,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg010:16c" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Phlb.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">16c</biblScope>
            </bibl>: freq. with a<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="comp" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Sup.</gram>
            </gramGrp>,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">κίνησις αὕτη μεγίστη δὴ . . ἐγένετο</foreign>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">this</tr>was notably the greatest movement which . . ,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:1" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.1</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:3:113" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.113</biblScope>
            </bibl>: with<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">πρῶτος</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:55" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.55</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:98" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">98</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:6:31" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">6.31</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0031.tlg003.perseus-grc1:2:2" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Ev.Luc.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.2</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="5" id="n76062.7" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">when<per opt="n" TEIform="per">3rd pers.</per>is used for<per opt="n" TEIform="per">2nd</per>to express contempt,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος ἀνήρ, οὑτοσὶ ἀνήρ</foreign>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg023:467b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Grg.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">467b</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg023:489b" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">489b</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.</sense>
          <sense n="II" id="n76062.8" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">though<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>usu. agrees with the Noun that serves as Predicate, it is not rare to find it in the neut.,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">μανία δὲ καὶ τοῦτ' ἐστί</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg017.perseus-grc1:305" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Ba.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">305</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τοῦτο γάρ εἰσι . . εὔθυναι</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg019.perseus-grc1:82" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">19.82</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, etc.: and in pl.,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐκ ἔστι ταῦτα ἀρχή</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0026.tlg003.perseus-grc1:13" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Aeschin.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.13</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ταῦτ' ἐστὶν ὁ προδότης</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0026.tlg002.perseus-grc1:166" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.166</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>: so with an explanatory clause added,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν ὁ συκοφάντης, αἰτιᾶσθαι μὲν πάντα ἐξελέγξαι δὲ μηδέν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg057.perseus-grc1:34" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">57.34</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>.</sense>
          <sense n="2" id="n76062.9" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">so also with a Noun in apposition,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τούτοισιν μὲν ταῦτα μέλει, κίθαρις καὶ ἀοιδή</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:1:159" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.159</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τούτου τιμῶμαι, ἐν πρυτανείῳ σιτήσεως</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg002.perseus-grc1:36e" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Ap.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">36e</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="Eur. Fr. 323.3" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Fr.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">323.3</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.</sense>
          <sense n="3" id="n76062.10" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">the neut. also may refer to a masc. or fem. Noun,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">καρπὸν φορέει κυάμῳ ἴσον</foreign>:<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τοῦτο ἐπεὰν γένηται πέπον κτλ</foreign>.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:4:23" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Hdt.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.23</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg006.perseus-grc1:1:5:10" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">An.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.5.10</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.</sense>
          <sense n="4" id="n76062.11" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">the neut. is also used of classes of persons,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">μελιτοπῶλαι καὶ τυροπῶλαι</foreign>:<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τοῦτο δ' εἰς ἕν ἐστι συγκεκυφός</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg002.perseus-grc1:854" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Ar.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Eq.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">854</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg034.perseus-grc1:711a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Lg.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">711a</biblScope>
            </bibl>; or of an abstract fact,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐκ Ἰοφῶν ζῇ;—τοῦτο γάρ τοι καὶ μόνον ἔτ' ἐστὶ λοιπὸν ἀγαθόν</quote>

          <sense n="b" id="n76062.18" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">exceptionally,<cit TEIform="cit">

              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">7.10c</biblScope>

              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">8.2</biblScope>

          <sense n="C" id="n76062.21" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense">SIGNIFICATION AND SPECIAL IDIOMS:</sense>
          <sense n="I" id="n76062.22" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">this</tr>, to designate<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">the nearer</tr>, opp.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐκεῖνος</foreign>,<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">that, the more remote</tr>,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ταῦτα</foreign>,<xr opt="n" TEIform="xr">
              <lbl opt="n" TEIform="lbl">like</lbl>
              <ref targOrder="U" lang="greek" TEIform="ref">τὰ ἐνταῦθα</ref>
            </xr>,<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">things round and about us, earthly things</tr>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg004.perseus-grc1:75e" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Phd.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">75e</biblScope>
            </bibl>(v. l.); cf.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅδε</foreign>init.: but<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>sts. indicates that which is not really nearest, but most important,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">δεῖ . . τὸ βέλτιστον ἀεί, μὴ τὸ ῥᾷστον λέγειν</foreign>:<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐπὶ ἐκεῖνο μὲν γὰρ ἡ φύσις αὐτὴ βαδιεῖται, ἐπὶ τοῦτο δὲ κτλ</foreign>.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg008.perseus-grc1:72" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">8.72</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg051.perseus-grc1:3" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">51.3</biblScope>
            </bibl>and<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">18</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="2" id="n76062.23" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">when, of two things, one precedes and the other follows,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅδε</foreign>prop. refers to what follows,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>to what precedes,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὐκ ἔστι σοι ταῦτ', ἀλλά σοι τάδ' ἔστι</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg007.perseus-grc1:787" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">OC</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">787</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅδε</foreign>III.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg007.perseus-grc1:2" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2</biblScope>
            </bibl>: freq., however, where there are not two things,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>refers to what follows,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:13:377" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">13.377</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:2:306" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.306</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὔκουν . . τοῦτο γιγνώσκεις, ὅτι</foreign>. . ;<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg003.perseus-grc1:379" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Pr.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">379</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.</sense>
          <sense n="3" id="n76062.24" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>is used emphat., generally in contempt, while<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐκεῖνος</foreign>denotes praise,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὁ πάντ' ἄναλκις οὗτος</foreign>, i.e. Aegisthus,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg005.perseus-grc1:301" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">El.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">301</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τούτους τοὺς συκοφάντας</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg003.perseus-grc1:45a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Cri.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">45a</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>; so<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">de Coron.</title>
            </bibl>uses<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>of Aeschines,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ἐκεῖνος</foreign>of Philip; but<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>is used of Philip,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg002.perseus-grc1:15" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.15</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg004.perseus-grc1:3" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.3</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="b" id="n76062.25" level="4" opt="n" TEIform="sense">of what is familiar,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τούτους τοὺς πολυτελεῖς χιτῶνας</foreign>, of the Persians,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg006.perseus-grc1:1:5:8" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">An.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.5.8</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οἱ τὰς τελετὰς . . οὗτοι καταστήσαντες</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg004.perseus-grc1:69c" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Pl.</author>
                <title TEIform="title">Phd.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">69c</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlg024:80a" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <title TEIform="title">Men.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">80a</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τὸ θυλακῶδες τοῦτο</foreign>the<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">familiar</tr>bag-like thing,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0093.tlg001:3:7:3" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Thphr.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">HP</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.7.3</biblScope>
            </bibl>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0093.tlg001:3:18:11" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.18.11</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0093.tlg001:4:7:1" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.7.1</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οἱ τὰς κόρας ταύτας ὠνούμενοι τοῖς παισίν</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0612.tlg001:31:153" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">D.Chr.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">31.153</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>.</sense>
          <sense n="4" id="n76062.26" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
            </gramGrp>law-language,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος</foreign>is commonly applied to<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">the opponent</tr>, whether plaintiff (as in<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0026.tlg002.perseus-grc1:130" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Aeschin.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.130</biblScope>
            </bibl>) or defendant (as in<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0026.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.1</biblScope>
            </bibl>); so, in the political speeches of<bibl default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">D.</author>
            </bibl>,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτοι</foreign>are<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">the opposite party</tr>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg004.perseus-grc1:1" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.1</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg008.perseus-grc1:7" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">8.7</biblScope>
            </bibl>, etc.; but in the forensic speeches,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτοι</foreign>freq. means<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">the judges, the court</tr>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg021.perseus-grc1:134" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">21.134</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0014.tlg036.perseus-grc1:47" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">36.47</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="5" id="n76062.27" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">much<abbr TEIform="abbr">like</abbr>an<pos opt="n" TEIform="pos">Adv.</pos>, in local sense (cf.<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅδε</foreign>init.),<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τίς δ' οὗτος κατὰ νῆας . . ἔρχεαι</foreign>; who art thou<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">here</tr>that comest . . ?<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:10:82" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">10.82</biblScope>
            </bibl>; freq. in<gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
              <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
            </gramGrp>,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">τίς οὑτοσί</foreign>; who's this<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">here?</tr>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0019.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1048" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">Ar.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Ach.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1048</biblScope>
            </bibl>;<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">πολλὰ ὁρῶ ταῦτα πρόβατα</foreign>I see many sheep<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">here</tr>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg006.perseus-grc1:3:5:9" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">X.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">An.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.5.9</biblScope>
            </bibl>(as v.l.): with Pron. of<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg006.perseus-grc1:2" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2</biblScope>
            </bibl>pers.,<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">οὗτος σύ</foreign>
            <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">ho</tr>you! you<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">there!</tr>
            <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg004.perseus-grc1:532" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">OT</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">532</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg004.perseus-grc1:1121" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1121</biblScope>
            </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg007.perseus-grc1:1280" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
              <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
              <title TEIform="title">Hec.</title>

                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">89</biblScope>

                <title TEIform="title">Med.</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">922</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>;<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">αὕτη σύ</quote>

                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">610</biblScope>

          <sense n="II" id="n76062.28" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">simply as antec. to<foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ὅς</foreign>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:2:40" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">173</biblScope>

          <sense n="IV" id="n76062.30" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">after a parenthesis, the Subject, though already named, is freq. emphat. repeated by<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">οὗτος, οὐδὲ γὰρ οὐδὲ Ἀριστέης . . , οὐδὲ οὗτος προσωτέρω . . ἔφησε ἀπικέσθαι</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:4:16" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Hdt.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.16</biblScope>

          <sense n="V" id="n76062.31" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
            <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">καὶ οὗτος</foreign>is added to heighten the force of a previous word,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ξυνεστῶτες . . ναυτικῷ ἀγῶνι, καὶ τούτῳ πρὸς Ἀθηναίους</quote>
              <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0003.tlg001.perseus-grc1:4:55" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                <author TEIform="author">Th.</author>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.55</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>, cf.<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:147" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">

              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.147</biblScope>

              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>
          <sense n="VI" id="n76062.32" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">repeated, where for the second we should merely say<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">he</tr>or<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">it</tr>,<cit TEIform="cit">
              <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">τοῖσιν τούτου τοῦτον μέλεσιν . . κελαδοῦντες</quote>

              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">200d</biblScope>

          <sense n="VII" id="n76062.33" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense">

                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1008</biblScope>
              </bibl>

          <sense n="2" id="n76062.35" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">

          <sense n="3" id="n76062.36" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense">

              <title TEIform="title">Smp.</title>
              <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">220c</biblScope>
            </bibl>.</sense>

                <title TEIform="title">IG</title>
                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">14.420</biblScope>
              </bibl>

              <lbl opt="n" TEIform="lbl">=</lbl>
              <ref targOrder="U" lang="greek" TEIform="ref">-τε</ref>

                <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">119.15</biblScope>
              </bibl>
            </cit>
            <date TEIform="date">(ii/iii A. D.)</date>.</sense>
